description: Creates an empty folder (an address segment such as /services; a folder is not a file), kept in .xodia/folders.json so it shows in the Pages panel and the plan before any page is in it. Folders that pages or collections use exist without this. Addresses are lowercase words with dashes, up to 5 folder levels; an address another page, folder or collection uses is refused with address_clash and the reason (a collection's item level, /blog/<slug>, belongs to its items unless the collection reserves that slug). Saved at once, like every edit in Xodia; pushing to Git and publishing stay the user's.

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

name.description: Its name in Studio and the default menu label; default from the slug

path.description: The folder's address ("services", or "services/web" inside services)

name: create_folder
title: Create a folder
